violations.why: The communicate ISR can preempt measure between the increment and the read-back, so tmp_tickCounter gets the reset value.
The communicate ISR resets tickCounter after measure reads it and before measure writes 0, so the reset is lost or the read value is stale.
The tickCounter++ read-modify-write can be interrupted by the communicate ISR's write, which then gets overwritten.
The intervalCounter++ read-modify-write is interrupted by the communicate ISR's reset, which the increment then overwrites.
numberOfRecords is reset between its use as the records index and the increment, so the record is stored at a stale index.
The numberOfRecords++ read-modify-write is interrupted by the communicate ISR's reset, which the increment then overwrites.
